title: Inventory existing generator and HQ Story plans
method: Read-only repository inspection. Every quote below resolves verbatim as a substring of the cited file:line at the baseline SHA. IMPLEMENTED rows cite executable source; PLANNED and ABSENT rows cite planning or audit documents.

rows.claim: The public Dock route /studio renders the GeneratorStudio client component.
rows.notes: Route page imports GeneratorStudio at line 3. The page is public Dock, not an authenticated HQ workspace.

rows.claim: GeneratorStudio is a real exported client component with avatar, seal and glyph tabs.
rows.notes: Tab ids avatar, seal and icons are declared at lines 718-722. The component has no server API call and no persistence.

rows.claim: MoonAvatar procedurally generates deterministic SVG avatars from a seed string.
rows.notes: Variants hoodie, crown, matrix and emblem are selected from the seed-driven PRNG. Output is inline SVG, not raster.

rows.claim: createPrng provides a deterministic pseudo-random stream from an input seed.
rows.notes: The module header documents an FNV-style hash and Mulberry32 stream. Same seed yields the same vector output.

rows.claim: StationSeal generates a procedural SVG station seal from station metadata.
rows.notes: Seed is composed from stationId, name and genre. Used by GeneratorStudio's HERALDIC SEAL FORGE tab.

rows.claim: GeneratorStudio exposes a fixed catalog of canonical glyphs for its glyph forge.
rows.notes: The catalog lists 20 icon entries ending at line 90. Glyph color, size and stroke width are adjustable in the client.

rows.claim: The studio serializes the preview SVG and downloads it as a .svg file.
rows.notes: Browser-only XMLSerializer/Blob path. Filename derives from avatar seed, station id or glyph name.

rows.claim: The studio rasterizes the preview SVG to a PNG at a default dimension of 1024.
rows.notes: The canvas draw and PNG data URL are created client-side at lines 699-708. No server renderer or media store is involved.

rows.claim: The studio copies serialized SVG markup to the clipboard.
rows.notes: Feedback text is shown for 2.5 seconds. This export path has no rights or consent check.

rows.claim: Headquarters renders a Story Forge module card that links to the generic model registry.
rows.notes: The card href is /models at line 306 and its description names stories, characters, worlds and narratives. It is navigation, not a story editor.

rows.claim: Headquarters renders a Poster Lab module card that links to the generic views registry.
rows.notes: The card href is /views at line 319. No poster canvas, layer stack or export gate is rendered by this card.

rows.claim: A dependency-free asset gate script exists and scans served assets against a rights ledger.

source.quote: UI-F14 icon/vector pipeline gate + QA-01 source/license ledger enforcer.

rows.notes: Observed run at this baseline reported 32 violations and exit code 1. The gate is executable, but the tree is red, so it does not certify served media.

rows.claim: A Story Forge screen plan exists with build and test leaves still unchecked; it is not built.
rows.notes: Only UI-P03a (audit) is checked at line 91. Leaves b through f remain open.

rows.claim: The Story Forge plan requires scene outline, character references and version save with real authorization, but the leaf is unchecked.

source.quote: - [ ] **UI-P03c · D3:** Scene outline, character references, version save with real authorization.

rows.notes: No scene editor or version store is present in code; see the ABSENT rows for scene storage.

rows.claim: A Poster Lab screen plan exists and assigns the existing GeneratorStudio as code owner before any new renderer.
rows.notes: The route is still 'private studio route TBD' at line 100. Only UI-P04a (audit) is checked.

rows.claim: The Poster Lab plan requires a canvas, layers, selected object and keyboard editing baseline, none of which is checked.

source.quote: - [ ] **UI-P04c · D3:** Canvas, layers, selected object and keyboard editing baseline.

rows.notes: The current studio has no canvas or layer model; it renders one flat SVG preview.

rows.claim: The Poster Lab plan requires an export preview, publish approval gate and negative-role test, still unchecked.

source.quote: - [ ] **UI-P04e · D3:** Export preview, publish approval gate and negative-role test.

rows.notes: Current exports download immediately with no approval step.

rows.claim: The canonical task for a story world, arc, episode, scene and version graph is open and unchecked.

source.quote: **M17-03** — Define story world, arc, episode, scene and version graph

rows.notes: Its acceptance condition is '99 chapter headings not treated as 99 originals'. M33-01 depends on it, so no story graph is claimed here.

rows.claim: The task to build a SHADOW editor as an HQ workspace on shared auth is open.

source.quote: **M17-05** — Build SHADOW editor as HQ workspace on shared auth

rows.notes: Acceptance requires private drafts and revision permissions controlled. No editor code exists.

rows.claim: Tracking original poster, music and derived media licenses and manifests is planned but unchecked.

source.quote: **M17-06** — Track original poster/music/derived media license and manifests

rows.notes: Its acceptance forbids unlicensed lyrics or external artwork. The mockup manifest separately flags license review.

rows.claim: The D07 scene version and media rights specification is open.

source.quote: **M33-03** — Specify D07 scene version and media rights

rows.notes: Depends on M33-02. No rights store or version store is claimed.

rows.claim: The single-renderer and HQ review handoff specification is open.

source.quote: **M33-04** — Specify single renderer and HQ review handoff

rows.notes: Depends on M33-03. Current studio is one client-side renderer, but no accepted single-renderer decision exists yet.

rows.claim: Private poster access and attribution verification is open.

source.quote: **M33-05** — Verify private poster access and attribution

rows.notes: Depends on M33-04. No private poster access path is claimed.

rows.claim: BLUEPRINT assigns world, arc, character, episode, scene and poster/media manifest to D07, consumed by a SHADOW workspace.

source.quote: | D07 | Story & Media | World, arc, character, episode, scene, poster/media manifest, editorial variants | SHADOW workspace consumes it |

rows.notes: This is an ownership boundary, not proof of models or UI. No D07 addon is present.

rows.claim: SHADOW is proposed for story, poster and media editing as an extraction of the HQ workspace.

source.quote: Story/poster/media editing and source-aware creative drafts

rows.notes: The same line says 'Proposed extraction of HQ workspace; D07 records, no parallel publisher'. No apps/shadow code exists.

rows.claim: The Story Forge reference exists only as a concept mockup marked CONCEPT_ONLY.
rows.notes: Screen 3 is titled STORY FORGE at line 37 and owned by 'HQ workspace, SHADOW proposed'. The manifest also declares notDeployed true.

rows.claim: The Poster Lab reference exists only as a concept mockup marked CONCEPT_ONLY.
rows.notes: Screen 4 is titled POSTER LAB at line 48 with owner 'existing GeneratorStudio, scoped SHADOW'.

rows.claim: The M33 milestone row declares the creative authoring surface planned with no implementation implied.
rows.notes: All five M33 leaves are unchecked at lines 726-730. M33-01 itself is the inventory leaf, not an implementation.

rows.claim: No scene version store exists in the inspected tree.

source.quote: there is no `scene_versions`, no rights store, and no review queue

rows.notes: The audit states this from the live registry and model inventory. No migration or model named scene_versions was found.

rows.claim: No D07 story package or addon is implemented.

source.quote: D07 has no implemented addon: no `packages/moonql-story*` exists

rows.notes: The cited audit enumerates the existing moonql packages and none is story-related. This inventory did not find a story package either.

rows.claim: No poster, asset or media_manifest model exists.

source.quote: Neither has a model: no `poster*`, `asset*` or `media_manifest*` name in `MODEL_NAMES`

rows.notes: Confirmed against the cited MODEL_NAMES inventory. No SQL migration in the repository names a poster or media manifest table.

rows.claim: No poster compositing pipeline exists: the studio has no canvas, layer stack or selected-object model.

source.quote: there is no canvas, no layer stack, no selected-object model

rows.notes: The existing studio renders one flat preview SVG per tab and exports it; there is no layered poster composition or project file.

rows.claim: No rights, consent or approval gate exists on the current SVG/PNG export path.

source.quote: **There is no rights check, no consent check, no approval step anywhere on that path.**

rows.notes: Download and clipboard handlers in GeneratorStudio call browser APIs directly. This is a rights/privacy constraint for any future poster export.

rows.claim: No SHADOW application code exists at this baseline.
rows.notes: The blueprint row groups SHADOW with Harbor, MoonLab, WORKS and HELIOGRID as future interfaces. apps/ contains no shadow directory.

rows.claim: The current /studio route has no authentication boundary; it is a public Dock demo.

source.quote: **there is no auth boundary on `/studio`, because Dock has no auth at all**

rows.notes: The public IA table corroborates 'Public generator, **DEMO**' at docs/design/M19-03-public-ia.md:35. Any private poster flow must move or wrap this host.

rows.claim: No story editor route exists in Dock or Headquarters.

source.quote: No `/projects`-style story route in Dock (§0.1) and no story route in HQ (§0.2).

rows.notes: The HQ Story Forge card links to /models, which is the generic model registry rather than a story workspace.

rows.claim: No story, scene, draft, arc or episode models exist, so there is no story data to edit.
rows.notes: The cited line lists the missing story_*, scene_*, draft_*, arc_* and episode_* model names. This inventory did not find them in code or migrations.

rows.claim: The documented `pnpm ui:assets` entry point is not present in any package manifest; only the underlying Node script exists.
rows.notes: Observed: scripts/check-ui-assets.mjs exists and runs directly, but grep over all package.json files found no ui:assets script. The asset gate is therefore documented but not wired as a package script.

rows.claim: The HQ Story Forge card renders literal counts '12 active projects' and '4 in review' with no query backing those values in the inspected component.
rows.notes: The badges are static JSX literals. Other cards on the page use monitor.counts, but these two do not. Treat the counts as unverified presentation, not inventory data.

rows.claim: The HQ Poster Lab card renders literal counts '8 in progress' and '3 queued' with no query backing those values in the inspected component.
rows.notes: Same pattern as the Story Forge card. The values are static and should not be read as live project counts.

rows.claim: The reference mockup set requires a license review that is not evidenced as completed in this inventory.
rows.notes: The manifest also marks the PNGs reference-only and notDeployed. No completed rights review was located; production use would need M17-06 and M33-05 evidence.
